ov: Waterbirds of the same family as geese and swans, but generally smaller and shorter-necked. Domestic ducks come mainly from the mallard, domesticated in China around 2000 BC.

why.p: Domestic ducks are raised for meat and eggs; a few are kept for show or as ornamental birds.
why.et: Domestic ducks, bred from the mallard, are raised for meat and eggs.

rg: Every continent except Antarctica, including some subantarctic islands.
df: Dabbling ducks feed by upending at the surface of fresh water; diving and sea ducks dive for fish and shellfish.

cf.tip: Ducks, geese and swans are one family. Ducks are generally smaller and shorter-necked than geese and swans.
